messages:
Sasha (SRE): paging: OrchidBank dedicated pool (orchid-prod-dedicated-7) is returning unredacted sensitive fields in debug logs after a recent debug flag flip. noticed by veg-monitoring alert at 09:12 UTC. stack: nginx -> inference-runtime -> log-shipper. attaching snippets below.

incidents-bot: @channel HIGH - tenant-impacting: orchidbank. pager duty escalation sent to oncall. incident id: INC-2026-0427-ORCHID.

Iyer (oncall): I'm on it. Can someone confirm whether this is log redaction at the shipper layer or in the runtime before emission?

Sasha (SRE): preliminary grep shows redaction regex not applied on the runtime side when debug_log=1. lines like: 
```
2026-04-27T09:11:58Z request_id=abc123 tenant=orchidbank model=gptx-v1 input="Customer SSN: 123-45-6789"
```
are making it through. log-shipper shows unredacted payloads in its buffer for ~2m before flush.

Ben (Infra): orchid-prod-dedicated-7 is on a pinned infra profile (nvme-quant-4). There's a recent hotfix deployed yesterday that changed log-level handling: toggled debug_log via configmap. Could be related.

Kevin (Customer Success): @Maria (Legal) FYI Orchid's legal team just messaged requesting immediate preservation of logs for an ongoing audit. They asked not to redact anything until legal has copy. They expect tick-tock and evidence for e-discovery. I'm copying them in DM.

Maria (Legal): We need to be careful. Standard procedure is: do not disable redaction globally without written legal approval and a documented narrow scope. For enterprise customers in VPC mode we can grant a time-limited export of raw logs if they have a legal hold. Provide: (1) business justification, (2) exact time window, (3) approved approver. I'll need a signed request or an email from Orchid's GC.

Iyer (oncall): Understood. For immediate mitigation, we can revert the debug flag to 0 to stop new unredacted logs. That will not purge data already emitted. Can we do a configmap rollback?

Ben (Infra): I can rollback the configmap to yesterday's revision. Command: 
```
kubectl -n orchid-prod patch configmap log-config --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/data/debug_log","value":"0"}]'
```
Will do now.

deploy-bot: configmap log-config rolled back in namespace orchid-prod by Ben. revision 2026-04-26-22 -> 2026-04-27-03.

Sasha (SRE): rollback done. stopping streaming to central shipper for this tenant temporarily. Running a consumer pause: 
```
redactctl pause --tenant orchidbank --component shipper --reason "incident ORCHID-1972501234" --duration 15m
```
This prevents further unredacted items being forwarded while we assess existing buffers.

Iyer (oncall): Good. Next: isolate existing unredacted buffers and snapshot them to a secure, access-controlled bucket with encryption and audit logs. Ben, can you snapshot and set KMS key rotation to customer-specific key? We need to minimize who can read plaintext.

Ben (Infra): snapshot started. Command used: 
```
kubectl exec -n orchid-prod shipper-0 -- tar -cz /var/log/shipper/buffer | gcloud storage cp - gs://redwood-incident-archive/orchidbank/1972501234-buffer.tar.gz --kms-key=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/orchidbank/cryptoKeys/orchid-key
```
Upload complete. Access restricted to a short ACL: only Legal and Infra SREs. Audit log entry: projects/redwood/logs/incident-archive/entries/1972501234.

Maria (Legal): Confirmed we have an incoming signed email from Orchid GC approving a 48h preservation window and access for Redwoods Legal + Orchid GC. Please attach the email to the incident record and include the exact S3 path. Also we need a chain-of-custody note: who accessed the snapshot and when.

Kevin (Customer Success): I've forwarded the Orchid GC email to Maria and to the incident thread DM. Orchid asked that raw logs be transferred to their secure SFTP once packaging is done. They provided a contact and account.

Sasha (SRE): Note: we intentionally did not re-enable shipper debug output. Current mitigation steps:
- rollback debug flag (done)
- paused shipper forwarding for tenant (done)
- snapshot buffers to KMS-protected bucket (done)
- enable read-only export to customer's SFTP after Legal signs off (pending)

Iyer (oncall): Action items and owners:
- Ben: confirm snapshot ACLs + upload verification (done)
- Maria: confirm legal acceptance and sign-off for export (pending)
- Kevin: coordinate Orchid's SFTP info and verify transfer readiness (pending)
- Sasha/Iyer: continue to monitor for any additional unredacted emission (monitoring rule ORCHID-RED-1 updated)

Ben (Infra): ACLs locked down and audit log recorded. Verified parity checksum: sha256: d2f3...b9c.

Maria (Legal): I have the signed email; approving a one-time export of the archived snapshot to Orchid's SFTP. Conditions: (1) transfer must use TLS+SFTP with host key verification, (2) transfer logged to legal audit bucket, (3) Redwood personnel must not retain a working copy after successful transfer. I will write a transfer approval note and post it here.

Iyer (oncall): Before we perform the export, confirm there are no running debug flags on any other orchid-prod pods. Run: 
```
kubectl -n orchid-prod get pods -l app=runtime -o jsonpath='{range .items[*]}{.metadata.name}: {.metadata.annotations.debug_log}\n'
```
Sasha: can you run that?

Sasha (SRE): ran, all runtime pods show debug_log=0 now. No further unredacted emission expected.

Ben (Infra): initiating SFTP upload job with ephemeral transfer instance. Transfer job id: xfer-1972501234. Command: 
```
transferctl start --src gs://redwood-incident-archive/orchidbank/1972501234-buffer.tar.gz --dest sftp://sftp.orchidbank.com/incoming/incident-1972501234 --hostkey-fp=SHA256:abcd... --kms-key projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/orchidbank/cryptoKeys/orchid-key
```
Transfer started.

deploy-bot: transferctl job xfer-1972501234 completed successfully. checksum verified. audit log appended.

Maria (Legal): Transfer verification received from Orchid GC. I am marking the legal hold as active for 48h and storing the signed export approval in the case record: cases/ORCHID/2026-04-27/export-approval.pdf. Chain-of-custody: Ben performed snapshot (09:17 UTC), Sasha paused forwarding (09:15 UTC), Ben performed transfer (09:34 UTC). No one inside Redwood read plaintext except those listed in ACL.

Kevin (Customer Success): Orchid's security contact confirmed receipt and validated checksum. They asked we rotate the SFTP credentials after transfer and send rotation confirmation.

Sasha (SRE): follow-ups: (1) add a telemetry rule to detect debug flag flips in configmaps for tenant namespaces (created ORCHID-DEBUG-FLIP alert), (2) add a gating step to our debug feature rollout to prevent clusterwide exposure, (3) update runbook on VPC redaction exceptions with exact steps we took. I'll open PRs.

Iyer (oncall): Good work team. I'll tidy the incident doc and add timeline. Closing the immediate page. If anything else crops up, reopen INC-2026-0427-ORCHID. :thumbsup:

incidents-bot: Incident INC-2026-0427-ORCHID marked as "mitigated" at 09:42 UTC.

Sasha (SRE): postmortem/owner: Sasha + Ben + Maria. I'll start the retrospective thread and link to the case notes and PRs.

Kevin (Customer Success): I'll schedule a post-incident call with Orchid to review controls and get their approval on the runbook changes.

Maria (Legal): I'll archive the legal records and confirm retention timeline. Legal hold expiry scheduled: 2026-04-29 09:12 UTC.

-- end of thread --
